decisions.reason: A black-finish variant extends the existing range at low marginal cost, follows a design trend, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.
A shower channel for seamless coverings sits at the core of the firm's barrier-free bathroom strategy, has a dedicated page signalling commitment, and draws on existing know-how.

The pump-assisted solution moves further from the core and is only mentioned on the website, so its results are less certain, but growth and slack let the firm carry it while it serves renovation niches.
A tileable floor drain is a close extension of the established offer with its own page, so it fits the design-led drainage portfolio and is cheap to maintain.
A stainless steel design grate uses the firm's own metal manufacturing and design positioning, and with satisfactory performance there is little reason to withdraw it.
